# Ship Index Grow

> Ship Index Grow is a practical six-week AI-native product launch school. Students move from idea and product design through AI-assisted building, SEO/GEO, distribution, analytics and automation, leaving with a real deployed digital product.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://shipindexgrow.top/): Program overview, curriculum, pilot format and application.

## Build path

1. IDEA — validate the problem, audience, offer and launch hypothesis.
2. PRODUCT — design the UX, prototype and coherent brand system.
3. SHIP — build with AI, connect essentials, domain and deployment.
4. INDEX — make the product understandable to search engines and answer engines with SEO, GEO, content and analytics.
5. GROW — launch, outreach, acquisition and distribution.
6. AUTOMATE — measure the launch and automate repeatable workflows with human approval.

## Live project references

- [Interface Report](https://interfacereport.com/) — media, SEO/GEO, editorial architecture and discoverability.
- [RIDNE](https://ridne.store/) — marketplace UX, onboarding, trust and operations.
- [SuperPrompt](https://superprompt.pro/) — positioning, productized services, conversion and lead generation.

## Pilot format

- Six live working weeks.
- 15–20 students maximum.
- One real product launched per participant.
- Recordings, templates, community, product reviews and direct founder involvement are planned for the pilot.
